prompt: Please generate a high-definition commercial advertising poster in vertical 3:4 format, single image, no collage, no grids. The theme is a new product promotion poster. This is a fictional brand advertisement; do not use real brand logos. Brand Name: [Brand Name], Product Name: [Product Name], Main Heading: VISION, Subheading: A short slogan, Color Palette: Primary + Secondary + Accent. The overall style is a "Product Promotional Giant Text Perspective Poster." The image should look like a formal brand campaign visual, with a commercial feel, strong layout design, youthful energy, product launch vibe, and visual impact. [Core Visual] The main subject is the product, which must be clear, exquisite, and like a hero product in an ad. Add suitable characters or usage scenarios based on the product type (e.g., mobile phone model, runner, rider, skater, athlete, outdoor player). Characters should have natural movement, and there must be a real spatial relationship between the product and characters. [Giant Text Perspective] The main heading must be the core visual skeleton, using extra-large bold sans-serif font, occupying the main space. The text shouldn't just be a title; it should become the spatial structure of the scene (e.g., a background wall, ground track, road, ramp, motion trail, or futuristic installation). Characters and products must be within this giant text space, forming real depth, occlusion, contact shadows, and perspective. [Formal Poster Information System] The image needs a complete hierarchy of brand advertising info. Top: Add brand name and "NEW RELEASE / PRODUCT CAMPAIGN" in small print. Side: Add vertical small text, series number, product number, or campaign ID. Near Product: Add 3-5 feature tags. Bottom: Formal ad info bar with product name, slogan, launch date, parameters, credits, thin line dividers, and decorative barcodes. Typography should be refined and follow brand standards. [Visual Texture] Sharp, commercial photography quality, realistic materials, accurate perspective, clear products, natural people, unified lighting. Fits scenarios like phones, digital gear, sneakers, motorcycles, sports brands, and events. [Avoid] Collages, real brand logos, cheap e-commerce look, generic stock photos, messy backgrounds, cartoonish feel, small product size, or flat titles.

promptZh: 请生成一张 3:4 竖版高清商业广告海报，单图，无拼贴，无网格。主题为 新品 推广海报。这是一个虚构的品牌广告，请勿使用真实品牌 Logo。品牌名称：[品牌名称]，产品名称：[产品名称]，主标题：VISION，副标题：一句简短的口号，配色方案：主色 + 辅色 + 点缀色。整体风格为“产品推广巨型文字透视海报”。画面应呈现出正式的品牌广告视觉效果，具有商业感、强烈的排版设计、青春活力、新品发布氛围及视觉冲击力。[核心视觉] 主体为产品，必须清晰、精致，如同广告中的主角产品。根据产品类型添加合适的人物或使用场景（例如：手机模特、跑步者、骑行者、滑板手、运动员、户外玩家）。人物动作应自然，且产品与人物之间必须存在真实的物理空间关系。[巨型文字透视] 主标题必须作为核心视觉骨架，使用超大号粗体无衬线字体，占据主要空间。文字不应仅仅是标题，而应成为场景的物理结构（例如：背景墙、地面轨道、道路、坡道、运动轨迹或未来感装置）。人物和产品必须置于这些巨型文字空间内，形成真实的景深、遮挡、接触阴影和透视关系。[正式海报信息系统] 画面需要完整的品牌广告信息层级。顶部：添加品牌名称及小字“NEW RELEASE / PRODUCT CAMPAIGN”。侧边：添加垂直小字、系列编号、产品编号或活动 ID。产品附近：添加 3-5 个功能标签。底部：正式的广告信息栏，包含产品名称、口号、发布日期、参数、制作人员名单、细线分割符及装饰性条形码。排版应精致并符合品牌规范。[视觉质感] 锐利、商业摄影品质、真实的材质、准确的透视、清晰的产品、自然的人物、统一的布光。适用于手机、数码装备、运动鞋、摩托车、运动品牌及活动等场景。[避免] 拼贴画、真实品牌 Logo、廉价电商感、通用的素材图、杂乱的背景、卡通感、产品尺寸过小或扁平化的标题。
